entities.summary: Nazym Abaiqyzy Qyzaibai is a Kazakh amateur boxer. She is her country's first three-time world champion having won the light-flyweight gold medal in 2014 and 2016 and the minimumweight title in 2025 and also bronze medalist at the 2024 Summer Olympics.
